word.title: Concept Header for the Concept of Graph Rules

conceptHeader.description: A graph rule is one sentence that a graph or an event meets or breaks. The test: a program can check it and answer pass or fail. A rule either refuses a write or only reports. Each rule's wording is written once, in the rulebook, docs/GRAPH_RULES.md in TapestryProtocol/tapestry. Each element of this concept is made from its entry there and from the rule's code, never kept by hand, so a rule is changed in the rulebook, not here.
